entries.speaker: Security Guard
entries.en: What business do you have here?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I had a feeling this would happen.
entries.uk: Так і знала, що до цього дійде.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'd like to speak with the bank president.
entries.uk: Я хотіла б поговорити з президентом[n]банку.

entries.speaker: Security Guard
entries.en: Excuse me, but do you have an[n]appointment?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I need to talk to him. Now let me through!
entries.uk: Мені треба з ним поговорити. А тепер[n]пропустіть мене!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.uk: Слухайте, а в банків бувають президенти?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Yes, but not the political sorts—in theory.
